articles.title: Why M&S director Kathryn Turner is the ultimate ‘Gay Halloween’ costume idea
articles.summary: Product development boss at Marks & Spencer inspires niche outfits after unexpected success on social media. She is not the most likely viral star. But with 310,000 followers on TikTok and 270,000 on Instagram, Marks & Spencer Food’s director of product development, Kathryn Turner, has suddenly…
body: Turner is part of Marks & Spencer’s wider social media strategy implemented in 2020 as a way of attracting younger shoppers. Instead of using traditional influencers, M&S now champions 100 of its own employees on TikTok.

Turner, who launched her account in May, now regularly receives more than 1m likes on her videos, with celebrities including Nigella Lawson and Stormzy among her followers. Part of the appeal is Turner’s insider knowledge and expertise: she has worked at M&S since 1995.

The content creator Liam Gleed has been posting videos of himself as Turner in the run-up to Halloween and plans to wear the costume this weekend. “To be very real, I love a sweet treat and I work close to an M&S so I follow her socials to find out what snacks I’ll be getting every Friday at work,” he says. “The more niche you go for Halloween, the better. Why go as basic characters when you can dress as your current fixation or icons of the internet?”

articles.title: I wrote a book about death. Here’s what people really think about dying
articles.summary: In the eight years since my graphic novel on death published, I’ve learned readers of all ages want to talk about loss and preserve their family’s stories. Becoming an author in my late 50s was unexpected, the result of my daughter Hallie’s own existential anxiety in her early 20s.
body: Fearing my untimely demise, she begged me to write down advice that would cover all of life’s bases going forward. I agreed, but put the project off for years; it wasn’t until she cornered me with a laptop on vacation that I gave in. She asked countless questions, and I found, to my surprise, that I had plenty to say. Hallie helped shape the manuscript, and then spent a year painting its warmly emotional gouache illustrations.

Our graphic novel, What to Do When I’m Gone: A Mother’s Wisdom to Her Daughter, was published in 2018. Though marketed for mothers and daughters, it holds my advice to all three of my children on moving forward after I die. Included are notes on grief and loss and life, plus a few recipes – not because I’m a great cook, but because food is so integral to family heritage. The book is a lighthearted, emotional and highly illustrated ode to moving forward and living life fully while grieving the loss of a parent or, really, anyone you love.

What we’ve learned in the eight years since its release is that readers of all ages have a deep hunger to know more about their parents’ backgrounds, beliefs and values, including around grief and loss.

articles.title: Ghost in the machine: how AI is haunting the search for the supernatural
articles.summary: Ghost hunting has changed in recent years due to AI chatbots, and paranormal enthusiasts are concerned. Ghost hunting is a tech-heavy pursuit. When Amy Waine and Jarrad Cutting investigate haunted locations, they’re loaded up with software of their own design, such as an app that assigns signals…
body: But for others in the ghost hunting world, AI is an unwelcome presence. Since the release of ChatGPT in 2022, AI-generated ghost stories and images of the supernatural have flooded online spaces, so much so that popular forums like the r/Nosleep subreddit, meant for scary stories, have implemented a strict policy against AI-generated material.

Waine and Cutting claim their app can generate images depicting the supernatural, using signals from a phone’s built-in magnetometer, identifying words and phrases in those signals, and then running them through an image generator.

Fellow paranormal enthusiasts can post the images they generate to a feed and comment on other users’ pictures. Since its release in 2023, Seer has become a regular part of their onscreen work. In a recent video on their Amy’s Crypt YouTube channel, the pair sat in a carefully selected location in the Winchester Mystery House while running GhostTube Seer.

articles.title: Steal My Food Itinerary: 3 Days on Prince Edward Island
articles.summary: Recently I spent a few days exploring Prince Edward Island, a place that embraces its local foodways with gusto. There’s a complex history here, with roots in Indigenous Mi’kmaq, Acadian, Irish, Scottish, and other cultures.
body: Canada’s smallest province is big on fresh produce, pristine seafood, gorgeous views, and warm conviviality.

On a stretch of land only about 140 miles long, you can eat oysters pulled out of nearby waters, potatoes grown on local farms, dig into a juicy burger made with PEI beef, and lick ice cream made with milk from the cows you pass along those famous red-dirt roads. That’s a lot of good eating packed into a place you can drive across in an afternoon.

I had to structure my visit, therefore, around where to dine, but also include a bucket-list visit to Green Gables Heritage Place. (I am a complete freak for L.M. Montgomery’s novel Anne of Green Gables, set on PEI around the turn of the last century.) I also had to schedule time at the PEI International Shellfish Festival, which promised endless trays of freshly shucked oysters and clams, hot buttered lobster rolls, steaming bowls of mussels, and plenty of entertainment, from shucking competitions and cooking demos to live music and dancing.

articles.title: We’re in the Era of the $200 Cup of Coffee
articles.summary: A version of this post originally appeared in Eater Today, which spotlights the freshest news and stories from across the food world every day. Subscribe now. These days, Bushwick is perhaps best known for its graffiti art, ecuavolley, and queer bars; the Brooklyn neighborhood is famous for its…
body: Bushwick’s Sey Coffee recently announced that it would be touring a rare Panamanian geisha from Finca Sophia, a coffee farm in Panama’s Chiriquí highlands. Sey scooped up the geisha at auction for $44,275, which comes to $6,325 per kilogram, or roughly $200 per cup. The geisha is billed as extraordinarily aromatic, floral, and juicy; Doug Cohen, Sey’s director of brand strategy, advises enjoying it with a clean palate, completely black, and taking your time with it. “As the coffee cools, different aspects of its character become apparent, and that evolution is part of the experience,” he says.

So, how did this coffee end up at this price? “We have been purchasing coffee from Finca Sophia for several years,” Cohen says. “This release really grew out of that existing relationship.” When Finca’s general manager told Cohen that the farm’s yields were down by approximately 95 percent, Cohen says a bigger question was raised: “What does it mean to be a good partner when the people you have built relationships with are facing a difficult year?” Buying up the geisha beans felt like a way to both support Sey’s producer, and further develop what Cohen calls “elevated coffee experiences.”
points: A version of this post originally appeared in Eater Today, which spotlights the freshest news and stories from across the food world every day.

articles.title: Angels & Demons: Inside ABT’s Theatrical and Fashion-Filled Fall Gala, Honoring Cynthia Erivo
articles.summary: American Ballet Theatre kicked off Halloweekend a little early on Thursday evening with its Angels & Demons–themed Fall Gala at Lincoln Center, honoring the shapeshifting talents of Grammy, Emmy, and Tony Award–winning actress, musician, and producer Cynthia Erivo
body: During cocktail hour, a fashionable crowd, which included designers Michael Kors and Phillip Lim, spilled onto the theater’s portico to enjoy the unseasonably warm October weather. Red devil horns dotted the crowd, though there was no shortage of heavenly apparitions. Bronx and Banco designer Natalie De’Banco, stylist Elizabeth Sulcer, and Nicky Hilton Rothschild channeled Charlie’s Angels in coordinating white looks, while Tina Leung looked positively celestial in a gold Jason Wu gown. Nearby, author Sarah Hoover, in a Carolina Herrera opera cape, Markarian gown, and Maison Michel halo juxtaposed her friend Charlotte Groeneveld’s sleek black look by Khaite.

Many of the dancers, who had to pull off lightning-fast changes after posing on the step-and-repeat ahead of the performance, took a less literal approach to the good-versus-evil dress code. “I chose black, silver, and gold to represent the theme,” said ABT’s fairy godfather PJ Pascual, the stylist who dressed Christine Shevchenko, Hee Seo, Scout Forsythe, and Lauren Bonfiglio in Monique Lhuillier sequins. Catherine Hurlin also embraced a little sparkle in Akris.

articles.title: Zara’s New Arrivals Have Fall and Winter Dressing Covered
articles.summary: From Leather Jackets to Party Dresses, Zara’s New Arrivals Have It All
body: If you’ve been waiting for an excuse to refresh your winter wardrobe before the holiday season kicks into high gear, Zara’s latest arrivals offer plenty of them. The Spanish retailer has been particularly busy lately, rolling out everything from party-ready pieces and fashion-forward workwear to cozy staples and new designer collaborations.

One of the key moments this week is the latest iteration of Zara’s partnership with Caramel London, the British label known for its playful prints and slightly nostalgic aesthetic. The new collection is filled with versatile separates, printed dresses, and charming accessories.

There are also still standout pieces available from last week’s fall/winter 2026 Studio release, Zara’s limited-edition line of premium-feeling fabrics and intricate details. This time around, the assortment feels especially suited to the holidays, with lace, jacquard-like textures, and embroidery appearing alongside a rich palette of tobacco, oxblood, and chocolate brown.

articles.title: Where to Eat, Stay, and Play on Easter Island, the Wild, Remote Island in the Pacific
articles.summary: Also known as Easter Island, this Polynesian isle has long been an aspirational destination—here's how to visit.
body: Today, this Chilean territory is essentially an open-air archaeological museum, with many of its enigmatic moai (representations of Polynesian ancestors) returned to their upright positions following seven decades of restoration. Of course to see Rapa Nui only through its superhuman past is to miss much of the story: The island’s distinct Polynesian culture remains a vital presence, particularly in its sole town, Hanga Roa, where nights come alive with cheerful ukulele music and hip-swirling dances. There’s also a vast, vibrant sea, windswept volcanic plains, and a food culture that draws on the island’s rich heritage and maritime setting.
As a repeat visitor to the island, this is my guide to Rapa Nui.

articles.title: You Heard it Here First: It’s Going to Be an Ugg Boot Fall
articles.summary: Ugg boots are an off-duty favorite for a reason. Here’s how to wear yours for the season, with outfit inspiration from a few of our favorite stylish celebs.
body: There’s something about the first crisp days of fall that calls for bringing your Ugg boots back into rotation. As temperatures dip, slipping into a plush pair is practically a seasonal rite of passage. But if you’re looking for fresh ways to wear the cold-weather staple, take a cue from the celebrities who are already making the rounds in their favorite pairs. From city strolls and flower runs to travel days and off-duty outings, these celebrity outfits offer plenty of inspiration for styling Ugg shoes all season long.

The key is incorporating them into your regular signature uniform, just as you would a favorite pair of loafers or ballet flats. For longtime fan Jennifer Lawrence, that means pairing a luxurious camel wrap coat and relaxed gray jeans with her go-to Classic Short II boots. In Zoë Kravitz’s case, it’s all about finishing a sport-coded windbreaker and black wide-leg pants with the Tasman II slippers. As for Bella Hadid, the Ultra Mini boots are a natural fit for her Western-inspired wardrobe, complementing a brown suede bomber jacket, a plaid shirt, and blue jean with just the right amount of cozy appeal.

articles.title: 8 Fresh Ways to Wear Corduroy Pants—To Work, on the Weekend, and Beyond
articles.summary: As seen on the fall 2026 runways, corduroy pants are a must-have. Shop the best pairs and discover how to style them now.
body: Like clockwork, corduroy pants make their initial cameo in the early fall. This year, however, they’re also having a moment on the runway—and in the latest street style. A mainstay at The Row—available in a variety of pant shapes—this season featured a handful looks built around the pant, starting off with a bright white pair and a little black jacket, following a light brown pant with sharp tailoring. At Tory Burch, a low-slung trouser with wide whale in a mustard hue stole the show, teamed up with light blue shirting and a wool sweater. At Isabel Marant, corduroys got a striking update in cobalt blue.

Throughout fashion month, we saw various sightings of corduroy—at times as a pant alone, other times as a full set. What makes the textured pant so compelling is its ability to straddle various sensibilities: classic yet of the moment; polished yet unpretentious, textural yet easy to style. As far as choosing your own pair goes, you can lean into fall’s playful mood by experimenting with bold hues or stay seasonally on theme with an earthy shade. We’ll show you it works with both, below.
